source.title: Enhanced Thermofluidic Modeling and Open Source Rigorous Simulation of Hydrogen Fueling Systems Validated with Real-world Data

minimum_acceptance: At least six de-identified complete fills with initial conditions, capacity/geometry, protocol or APRR metadata, units, calibration and written reuse terms.
claim_boundary: Paper and public code establish provenance and a request lead only; no numerical validation claim is permitted without the raw synchronized files and a pre-outcome freeze.
